what_it_does: This work develops tiny, sensitive thermometers distributed across a single chip to detect and map localized hot spots with extreme precision—down to 100 microns of spatial resolution and fine time steps. Modern AI accelerator chips generate uneven heat because different parts run different workloads at different intensities, creating dangerous thermal gradients (temperature can vary by more than 10 degrees Celsius across a tiny distance). The chip demonstrated here integrates a buck converter (a power management circuit) and an emulated AI workload to validate that these micro-scale thermal sensors can capture the real temperature landscape. This fine-grained monitoring enables better thermal management and prevents performance throttling and silicon damage.
